title: Sarah S NDE 2533
content: I remember falling to the ground. The next memory I had is I was under water looking up out of the water at a boat. The boat had a person in it with a bright light behind them, it was like when you are in a pool, you look up from under the water, and you can see the sunshine. I think it was a man. He was reaching out to me as I swam towards the surface. His hand was extended reaching towards me right before we made contact, I felt like I was not going to make it like I was drowning. That is when I was revived via CPR by my step-mother, and I vomited all over her. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: Don't really know exact date NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes seizure Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? No No How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Never, I was dead. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Things seemed to move in slow motion. Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I am not really sure how to answer this. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. There was no sound. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes The person was in a boat, it seemed like they were trying to help me. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? Yes It was behind the person in the boat. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place I was under water in a place I have never seen bofore What emotions did you feel during the experience? I was scared, I thought I was drowning. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Neither Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate I grew up Lutheran, but only attended as a child did not attend around that time Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Moderate I still believe in God, I always have Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes My step-mother and I became very close after she saved my life. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes The person I had seen I have never seen prior to this experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes It took a few days to tell my step mother and then years to tell some of my friends. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I was a teenager I really didn't care or believe in these things. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I had the feeling of drowning and when I came to immediately after I vomited like a drowning victim would. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real It just seemed so real. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Grew up Lutheran; moderate; did not attend around that time; still believes in God.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Underwater scene with a boat and a person reaching out; revived by CPR and vomited.
